response.sql: SELECT AVG(team_loss_rate) AS average_loss_rate FROM (SELECT team_id, AVG(1.0 * l / g) AS team_loss_rate FROM manager_half WHERE g > 53 AND team_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY team_id) AS team_averages

assumptions.assumption: A team is identified by team_id across all years; each qualifying stint contributes equally to its team's average.

alternatives.interpretation: Treat each team in each year as a separate team.
